tech.summary: Reuters ke mutabiq Jensen Huang ne Nvidia ke general counsel Tim Teter aur CMO Alison Wagonfeld ko bhi apne affair ki asal nature ke baare mein gumrah kiya — internal messages ke mutabiq unhon ne Megaspeed ki Alice Huang se taluqat ko 'routine business' bataya. Nvidia ke shares 6 October ki peak se 30% se zyada gir chuke hain, market cap mein $1.8 trillion se zyada ka nuqsan. Board ne Wachtell Lipton ko independent investigation ke liye hire kiya hai; earnings 17 November ko hain.
tech.title: Huang scandal gehra — ex-Nvidia CEO ne top lawyer ko bhi gumrah kiya, shares 30% neeche

tech.summary: Reuters ke mutabiq Anthropic ka IPO roadshow ke teesre din tak 6 guna oversubscribed ho gaya — SpaceX ke IPO se bhi zyada demand. 825 million shares $70–78 par, pricing 18 November aur trading 19 November se Nasdaq par ticker ANT ke neeche. Lekin investors sawaal utha rahe hain: kya Claude ki lead Google ke muqable mein tik payegi, aur 2028 revenue $270–280bn ka projection kitna real hai?
tech.title: Anthropic ka IPO 6 guna oversubscribed — $64bn deal, $1.4 trillion valuation ki taraf

tech.summary: Microsoft ke Outlook, Teams aur Copilot 12 November ko 12 ghante se zyada ke liye global outage ka shikar rahe — 430 million se zyada users mutasir. Taipei mein trades fax se confirm hui, Euronext ne listed companies ko phone karne ko kaha, Aviva ne Bluetooth se recordings transfer ki. Microsoft ne server problems ko zimmedar thehraya, koi malicious activity nahi mili. 13 November tak recovery jaari thi.
tech.title: Microsoft 365 ki 12 ghante ki outage — duniya bhar mein fax aur phone wapas

tech.summary: AI agent management startup LangChain ne $300 million Series C raise kiya, valuation $3 billion — aik saal pehle $1.25bn thi. Round CapitalG ne lead kiya, GIC, DFJ Growth, IVP aur Sapphire ne hissa liya. LangChain 2022 mein open-source project se shuru hua tha; ab us ka LangSmith platform 7,000 customers ko serve karta hai, jin mein Nvidia, Toyota aur Salesforce shamil hain.
tech.title: LangChain $3bn ki company ban gayi — AI agents ka boom ab funding mein nazar aa raha hai

tech.summary: AMD ne Instinct MI400 accelerator series launch ki — MI430X mein 432GB HBM4 memory aur 288 teraflops FP64 performance. AMD ka daawa hai ke MI430X ki memory Nvidia ke Vera Rubin platform se 50% zyada hai. Nvidia ki leadership crisis ke beech AMD ka ye launch AI chip race mein aik bara move hai; Dell ne bhi MI400 par based servers announce kar diye.
tech.title: AMD ne MI400 chips launch kar diye — Nvidia ko seedha challenge

tech.summary: OpenAI ne ChatGPT Wallet launch kar diya — us ke 'dots' agents ab aap ki taraf se purchases kar sakte hain, bina asal card details dekhe. Har purchase par security check (Face ID/fingerprint) zaroori hai. Amex, Mastercard aur Visa ke saath banaya gaya; shuru mein sirf US ChatGPT Pro subscribers ke liye. Aage ja kar spending limits aur categories set kar ke poori delegation bhi mumkin hogi.
tech.title: ChatGPT Wallet aa gaya — ab AI agent aap ke liye khareedari bhi karega

pakistan.summary: ISPR ke mutabiq security forces ne Khyber Pakhtunkhwa aur Balochistan mein intelligence-based operations mein 74 dehshatgard halak kar diye — Mir Ali aur Orakzai mein 48 ghanton mein 43, aur Quetta ke Kurram area mein 3 November se shuru operation mein 31. Bari miqdar mein hathiyar, gola-barood aur IEDs bhi baramad hue. Azm-i-Istehkam ke tehet operations jaari rahenge.
pakistan.title: 74 dehshatgard halak — KP aur Balochistan mein bari IBOs, ISPR

pakistan.summary: Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum 2026 13 agreements aur MoUs ke saath khatam — 60 mumalik ke delegates shirkat kar gaye. FWO ne Chagai ke Dasht-i-Kain area mein 350 million tonnes copper ka andaza lagaya. PM Shehbaz ne kaha 'mine in Pakistan, process in Pakistan, manufacture in Pakistan'; Barrick Karachi aur Gwadar mein processing facilities mein dilchaspi rakh raha hai. Reko Diq se production 2028 mein shuru hone ki umeed.
pakistan.title: Minerals forum mein 13 deals — Chagai mein 350 million tonnes copper ka inkishaf

pakistan.summary: KSE-100 ne jumma ko 500.11 points ka izafa kar ke 177,873.88 par close kiya. Mari Minerals ne Chagai ke East Siah Diq target par porphyry copper-gold discovery announce ki, jis ke baad late buying ne early losses ko reverse kar diya. MARI, Lucky Cement, PPL aur Fatima Fertiliser ne mil kar 722 points ka izafa diya. Volume 1.04 billion shares raha.
pakistan.title: PSX 500 points up — Mari ki copper-gold discovery ne market ko utha diya

pakistan.summary: Pakistan ne UN Security Council mein Saudi Arabia ke khilaf Houthi hamlo ki mazammat ki aur Yemen mein Yemeni-led siyasi hal par zor diya. Council ne Houthis par sanctions 14 November 2027 tak barha diye aur drone/missile parts ki supply rokne ke iqdamat kiye. Pakistan ke mustaqil numainde Syed Haider Shah ne kaha Saudi Arabia ko apne ilaqe aur shahriyon ke difa ka jaiz haq hai.
pakistan.title: Pakistan ne UN mein Saudi Arabia ki himayat ki — Houthi hamlo ki shadeed mazammat

pakistan.summary: Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb ke mutabiq Pakistan ki sovereign Sukuk issuance Rs10 trillion se upar chali gayi — is saal 113% izafa, 2025 ke taqreeban Rs2 trillion se. Meezan Bank ke mutabiq Jan–Oct mein Rs4.179 trillion ke Sukuk beche gaye. Lekin wazir ne khud mana: 'foreign investment in Sukuk remains underwhelming'. Ab retail investors ko digital platforms se Rs5,000 se invest karne ki dawat di ja rahi hai.
pakistan.title: Sukuk issuance Rs10 trillion se upar — lekin foreign investors abhi bhi door

pakistan.summary: Peshawar se Quetta jaane wali Jaffar Express ki power van aur do coaches Rawalpindi ke qareeb Noor Railway Station par patri se utar gaye. Koi casualty ya injury nahi hui. Rail traffic aarzi tor par band rahi, phir obstruction clear kar ke operations dobara shuru kar diye gaye. Inquiry shuru kar di gayi hai.
pakistan.title: Jaffar Express ke 2 coaches patri se utar gaye — koi jani nuqsan nahi
